title: Midweek surge tactical pad
content:
MIDWEEK SURGE - tactical pad
Kenji Sato — 05/06/2026
Goal: push 18 outbound touches 3:00–6:00pm ET, aim for 4 connects / 2 meetings booked. Focus: EMEA expansion targets + 3 high-value US accounts that showed intent last month.

Quick plan (timeboxed)
- 2:50pm: prep notes, pull fresh contact data, quick refresh of account context (What changed since last touch?)
- 3:00–4:00pm: high-priority warm list (accounts with prior demo, open RFP, or inbound signal)
- 4:00–5:00pm: new accounts (prospect expansion from same ICP vertical) + voicemails
- 5:00–6:00pm: follow-up emails, LinkedIn nudges, update CRM & set next steps

Target KPIs today
- Touches: 18
- Calls: 12
- Connects: 4+
- Meetings: 2 (or 2 solid next steps)
- VMs left: 6 (leave tailored vm for execs)

Priority call list (order = high -> low)
1) Lendwise (Eur fintech) — Priya Bhatt (Head of Eng) — warm. Last convo: infra constraints + cost sensitivity.
   Quick note: mentioned Dedicated capacity for compliance. Ask: 20–30 min about latency guarantees + proof-of-cost calc.
   Next step: push for Thurs 10am GMT.

2) CampusFlow (US edtech) — Marcus Lee (CTO) — inbound demo 03/22. Needs fast embeddings for search.
   Snippet: emphasize Redwood Optimize recommendations for small-batch retrain and embedding cache -> lower cost.
   VM script: "Marcus, Kenji at Redwood — quick note on embeddings cache idea that could cut infra spend by ~30%"

3) Statly (US analytics) — Lisa Gomez (Platform lead) — trial usage low last week.
   Tactic: highlight autoscaling + burst capacity (Dedicated) for predictable spikes; offer short pain-points checklist to diagnose low adoption.

4) BrightCart (latam retailer) — Carlos (Head of Product) — cold; found via dataroom.
   Plan: quick intro, qualify latency SLOs & security. If signs of fit, ask for architecture diagram (high-level).

5) Nimbus Health (healthcare) — compliance blocker.
   Note: emphasize Private deployment + KMS/HSM options. Ask for SOC2 / HITRUST conversation with security champion.

6) Follow-up cluster (smaller accounts) — rapid 3-min calls, leave vms for high LTV ones.

Voice mail / VM templates (short + specific)\- VM A (exec): "Hi {Name}, Kenji from Redwood. Quick note — we've helped similar teams reduce generative inference spend and stabilize latency for production users. If you want a 10-minute example that maps to your stack, ring me back at [phone]."
- VM B (engineer): "Hey {Name}, Kenji at Redwood. Saw your note about embeddings. I have a quick test idea to evaluate cache hit rate in 10 minutes — call me at [phone]."

Email subject A/B (for follow-ups immediately after a call or voicemail)\- A: "3 quick ideas to cut inference cost at {Company}"
- B: "One question about {Company} latency targets"

Rapid qualification checklist (1–2 min on call)
- Production or POC?
- Current model + provider? (open model / vendor)
- Peak tokens / typical sequence length? (gives hint on cost)
- Security/regulatory constraints? (PCI/HIPAA/SOC2)
- Decision timeline + stakeholders

Objection handling cheatsheet
- "We build it ourselves" -> "Totally get it — quick bench: our runtime optimizations and caching often reduce cost 20–40% vs naive self-hosting for similar models; I can share a short technical note."
- "Too expensive" -> "If cost is the blocker, let's run a short sizing exercise — I can map your traffic to an expected monthly spend and show likely savings with batching + caching."
- "Not now / budget cycle" -> "When's your next planning cycle? I can pencil a follow-up in and send a one-page ROI for leadership."

Notes-to-self / reminders
- Send Marcus (CampusFlow) the sample embedding cache diagram + simple cost calc (1-pager) after the call.
- Ask product for a 1-slide on "Dedicated burst capacity" (ops talk) — Aisha is looped.
- Add BIOS of security engineer for Nimbus Health; schedule intro with our security lead if they ask.

CRM updates after surge
- Mark outcomes with tags: connect / vm-left / follow-up-email / meeting-booked
- Set 3-day reminder for any 'no answer' that had high signal

End-of-day wrap (5–6pm)
- Tally: touches vs goal, quick notes on what worked (scripts, times), top 2 reused snippets, list of 3 follow-ups to prioritize tomorrow.
- Update team slack short summary: wins + blockers + 2 asks (tech collateral / security intro).

Random scratch ideas (testing)
- Try subject line with emoji for low-touch folks (A/B test next week).
- Micro-survey in follow-up email: 2 questions — "Is latency or cost the bigger issue?" + "Would a 10-min call with cost example be useful?"

Today’s blockers
- Missing contact for Lendwise security lead (ask Marco offline)
- Need quick 1-pager: "Why Dedicated vs Hosted for regulated apps" from product marketing — pinged Aisha.

Quick personal checklist (non-work)
- Lunch prepped? yes/no? (if no: order before 2:30)
- Gym: squeeze 30-minute walk after calls

— end —
(Keep this as working pad; will clean and push top items to CRM notes after 6pm)
